central_claim: Neither OpenAI nor Anthropic is acting responsibly with frontier AI, and both are racing towards dangerous self-improving superintelligence.
stance_note: agree = accepts that neither OpenAI nor Anthropic is acting responsibly and that racing towards self-improving superintelligence is a danger worth resigning over; disagree = rejects this, on any grounds (capability scepticism, geopolitics, IPO cynicism, or defending the labs); mixed = accepts part of the danger claim while rejecting or reframing another part, for example disputing that resigning was the right response.
coder_instructions: Code the reply as posted; quote-tweets, the parent tweet's text and prior replies in the thread are not supplied as context. Comments with no readable position (jokes, one-liners, pure reactions to format) are stance na; genuinely ambiguous attempts at a position are unclear, used sparingly. When a comment fits two frames, pick the one it leads with. Rows with no text (GIF, image or sticker-only replies the platform exposed no text for) are marked coder=not_coded_empty_stub, with placeholder codes (stance na, frame format_only, format_reaction none, emotion neutral) rather than left blank.

values.label: Agree
values.definition: accepts that neither company is acting responsibly and the danger described is real

values.label: Disagree
values.definition: rejects this, on any grounds

values.label: Mixed
values.definition: accepts part, rejects or reframes part

values.label: Na
values.definition: on topic but no readable position

values.label: Unclear
values.definition: genuinely cannot be told either way; used sparingly

values.label: Capability scepticism
values.definition: doubts current or near-term AI can do what Coxon describes
values.example: We aren't going to die out because a token prediction model gained sentience. Get a grip.

values.label: China race
values.definition: argues unilateral restraint just hands the advantage to China or another geopolitical rival

values.label: Format only
values.definition: reacts only to the thread's tone, length or format rather than its content
values.example: Well this was a pleasant read right before bed.

values.label: General agreement
values.definition: endorsement without a distinct argument

values.label: Technical argument
values.definition: makes a substantive technical claim about how the danger would or wouldn't unfold
values.example: Imagine the next big war isn't kinetic, it doesn't involve bombs or guns. It doesn't even involve people - it's between AI models.

values.label: Blame people
values.definition: accepts the danger is real but locates the fault in human greed, elitism or the desire for control rather than the technology itself
values.example: This is exactly why AI needs to be people-owned, not controlled by a handful of billionaires.

values.label: How to act
values.definition: asks or proposes what an ordinary person, or anyone, should actually do in response
values.example: Can someone explain what we non-tech non-billionaire non-bunker owning people are supposed to do with this information?

values.label: Scifi
values.definition: frames the claim through film, book, game or other fiction

values.label: Hypocrisy critique
values.definition: argues that quitting is the wrong response if Coxon genuinely believes what he says
values.example: if you really believe this you stay on the job and sabotage the progress, what does resigning do?

values.label: Messenger authenticity
values.definition: questions or defends whether Coxon's resignation and stated motives are genuine, as opposed to arguing about the danger claim itself
values.example: Be real bro you did it for the Aella incentive and aura farming points.

values.label: Ipo marketing cynicism
values.definition: reads the whole thread as promotional and timed to Anthropic's pending IPO

values.label: Fatalism
values.definition: accepts the danger but responds with resignation or nihilism rather than a call to act

values.label: Conspiracy or other target
values.definition: reframes the thread as a paid, staged or PR operation for Anthropic, OpenAI or another party, rather than a sincere resignation
values.example: wait bro this is the latest round of Anthropic PR lol can't believe I didn't see it at first.

values.label: Religion or spiritual
values.definition: frames the danger, or Coxon's role, in religious or spiritual terms
values.example: If AI apocalypse is our downfall then that is gods will.

values.label: Present harms
values.definition: argues the more pressing danger is nearer-term harm, such as jobs or economic disruption, rather than existential risk
values.example: either we think this technology kills us all, or we think it takes all of our jobs

values.label: Benefits
values.definition: argues AI's benefits outweigh the risk described, or that stopping or slowing development is the real danger
values.example: We will not throw away a utopian paradise for a small chance of it not working.

values.label: Other
values.definition: doesn't fit any of the above, including off-topic tangents and undifferentiated hostility

values.label: None
values.definition: no distinct reaction to the thread as a piece of writing, beyond the content argument itself

values.label: Mock
values.definition: mocks or ridicules the thread, Coxon, or the situation, rather than engaging its content

values.label: Condescended
values.definition: responds with a condescending or patronising tone towards Coxon

values.label: Imitates
values.definition: imitates or parodies Coxon's writing style or voice

values.label: Praise
values.definition: praises Coxon, the thread, or the decision to write and post it, as a piece of communication

values.label: Neutral
values.definition: dominant emotional register: neutral

values.label: Fear
values.definition: dominant emotional register: fear

values.label: Anger
values.definition: dominant emotional register: anger

values.label: Resignation
values.definition: dominant emotional register: resignation

values.label: Humour
values.definition: dominant emotional register: humour

values.label: Hope
values.definition: dominant emotional register: hope

values.label: mentions_messenger_credentials
values.definition: names Coxon's own career history, credentials, or trustworthiness as the messenger, attacking or defending them

values.label: mentions_leaders_policy
values.definition: governments, regulators, politicians, treaties, courts, law

values.label: mentions_companies_billionaires
values.definition: names companies, investors, billionaires, bubble, IPO

values.label: mentions_cultural_reference
values.definition: references any film, book, game or fictional AI/robot

values.label: mentions_asks_what_to_do
values.definition: asks or proposes what should be done

values.label: mentions_china
values.definition: mentions China, or geopolitical AI-race dynamics, specifically

values.label: mentions_ipo
values.definition: specifically invokes Anthropic's pending IPO, or reads the thread as promotional or timed to it (narrower than mentions_companies_billionaires, which covers company and investor mentions generally)

values.label: non_english
values.definition: mostly not in English
